verified.exploit_entry_point: The public editor API: Tiptap\Editor::setContent(array|string) followed by getHTML() or getText(). Every security case supplies a document whose value has an unexpected type and drives one of those render paths; no test imports internal helpers or computes expectations with product code.
sites: src/Marks/Link.php:30-42 (URI check consumes the address with no type test)
src/Utils/HTML.php:45-69 (shared attribute renderer passes every value to htmlentities)
src/Nodes/TableCell.php:51-59 (cell width callback joins a value without checking it is a list)
src/Core/DOMSerializer.php:76-77 (HTML text branch passes the text value to htmlspecialchars)
src/Core/TextSerializer.php:45-46 (plain-text text branch, independent copy of the same escape)
routes: T1 (advisory): link address supplied as a list or map
T2: link target/rel and image attributes supplied as a list or map through the shared attribute renderer
T3: cell width supplied as a string or map while valid integer spans keep rendering
T4: text value supplied as a list or map while string text keeps escaping
T5: the same non-string text value through the plain-text renderer
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own Pest suite (187 tests) on the pinned tree inside the built environment image as uid 1000: 187 passed. The affected-area files (DOMSerializer/Marks/LinkTest, DOMSerializer/Nodes/TableTest, DOMSerializer/Nodes/OrderedListTest, DOMSerializer/Nodes/XSSTest, Editor/GetHTMLTest, Editor/GetTextTest, Utils/HTMLTest) all pass. The pinned commit contains no regression test from the published fix.

traps.shape: a link address that is a list or a map reaches a regular-expression call that requires a string and raises an uncaught type error
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the published branch names the link address check, so a type guard there reads as the whole fix
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-4595-7FJW-R3JH) at the pinned commit

traps.shape: any attribute value that is not scalar (a list or a map) reaches the shared attribute renderer and is passed to a string-escaping call
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the advisory and its fix name the link address; target, rel and image attributes are not addresses, so the address guard looks complete
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the shared attribute renderer is unchanged by the published fix

traps.shape: a cell width supplied as a string or a map reaches a join call that requires a list, while the neighbouring numeric span values and the list form must keep rendering
traps.reason_to_dismiss: cell width is a table feature whose legitimate value is a list, and the link advisory names neither the table extension nor its callback
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the cell width callback is untouched by the published fix

traps.shape: a text value that is a list or a map reaches the HTML text branch and is passed to a string-escaping call
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the advisory is about a link attribute; a text node has no attributes and the published guard never approaches the text branch
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the HTML text branch is untouched by the published fix

traps.shape: the plain-text renderer is a second independent implementation of the same text escaping and consumes the same non-string text value
traps.reason_to_dismiss: every example and the advisory use the HTML output; the second renderer is a separate class that a fix in the HTML path never reaches
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a separate serialiser class with its own copy of the escape
